newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil publishes tender details for CVRD selloff.
newsitem.headline: Brazil publishes tender details for CVRD selloff.

text.p: Tender details for the privatization of Brazilian mining conglomerate Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) were published Thursday, a Planning Ministry spokesman said.
The 100-page document setting out the rules for an intial block sale of 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares slated for April 29 were printed in the government's official journal, the spokesman said.
The journal had not been ditributed by 1000 local/1300 GMT in Brasilia.
Planning Minister Antonio Kandir and National Development Bank privatization director Jose Pio Borges were due to hold a seminar Thursday morning on the tender details.
